schedule.extended_period_policy: Use Period 6 only when no other slot is available

hard_constraints: A student must never have two courses scheduled in the same time slot
No class of any kind may be scheduled during the lunch break (12:30 to 13:30)
Lab blocks (practical sessions) must occupy exactly 2 consecutive periods on the same day
A lab block must never span from Period 3 into Period 4 as this crosses the lunch break
Valid lab blocks are: P1+P2, P2+P3, P4+P5, P5+P6 only
Each course must be assigned exactly its theory_hours_per_week theory slots per week
Each course must be assigned exactly its practical_hours_per_week practical hours per week, placed as 2-hour lab blocks
Do not assign more slots than a course requires — stop exactly at the required hours
Theory hours should be spread across different days of the week where possible
Lab blocks are preferred in the morning and afternoon  (P1+P2, P2+P3, P4+P5, P5+P6)
Period 6 (extended) should be used as a last resort only

Parallel Block Synchronization: When elective courses run in parallel for a department batch, they must occupy the exact same time slots. A 1-hour theory course must NEVER be scheduled parallel to only one half of a 2-hour lab block. If a course has a 2-hour block (e.g. P4+P5), any parallel elective running in that block must also occupy BOTH periods (P4 and P5) so that no students in the batch are left idle during either period.
soft_constraints: Single-department courses are preferred in the morning (P1, P2, P3)
Cross-department courses are preferred in the afternoon (P4, P5)
Avoid placing all theory hours of one course on the same day
